title: ever NOIR|Asymmetric Shoulder with Bow Knit Black Tie Formal Dress
descriptionHtml:
Made for black tie moments when you want drama without the fuss. The asymmetric shoulder draped neckline gives a clean sculpted look, while the statement bow and long sash add movement that photographs beautifully. The streamlined column skirt keeps everything polished and easy to walk in, so it works for galas, black tie optional dress codes, formal weddings, charity dinners, and evening receptions where you want to look elevated but still feel comfortable all night.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Side right zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises knit.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
